# ThunderStudy PDF

> Free study PDFs and a browser flipbook reader for students.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thunderstudypdf.indevs.in/): searchable PDF library and categories.
- [Open a PDF](https://thunderstudypdf.indevs.in/pdf): upload a PDF or paste a direct PDF link.
- [Reader](https://thunderstudypdf.indevs.in/reader): interactive DearFlip PDF reader.

## Topics

Science, Commerce, Humanities, Economics, CUET, General Knowledge, sample papers, question banks, boards preparation.
